RUNBOOK: AMBER LAG

Document ID: amber-lag-runbook
Revision ID: r1
Valid from: 2026-03-15T00:00:00Z
Valid to: open
Owner: Finch Team
Applies to: Aster Relay

TRIGGER

The amber-lag alert fires when the oldest unacknowledged Aster Relay batch is older than 140 seconds for three consecutive samples.

TRIAGE

1. Confirm that svc-aster-relay is accepting batches.
2. Check whether queue-quartz-ring depth is increasing.
3. Compare the oldest batch age with the current acknowledgement window.

MITIGATION

Pause intake from the Juniper Agent. Leave the Quartz Ring online. Restart only Lumen Processor workers that hold stale leases. Resume intake after the oldest batch age remains below 70 seconds for two samples.

ESCALATION

Escalate to the Finch Team if queue depth keeps increasing for 10 minutes after mitigation or if any `μ7` batch fails checksum validation.
